content: Rohan Deshmukh called insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to discuss his home insurance quote of ₹18,750 per year for a ₹30 lakh sum insured. Rohan has the property deed and electricity bill ready but is still waiting on the fire-safety certificate. Sunita agreed to proceed with the available documents and flag the certificate as pending. Rohan also inquired about the deductible, which Sunita confirmed is ₹5,000 for fire damage and all other perils. Rohan will email the documents immediately.

action_items: Rohan to email the property deed and electricity bill
Sunita to upload documents to the portal
Rohan to provide the pending fire-safety certificate
